item.noellesroles.fake_grenade.tooltip:
Left click to switch between direct throw and charge throw
In direct throw mode, right click throws immediately at base speed; in charge mode, hold right click for up to 1 second before release

On impact it plays the same explosion sound and particles as a real grenade, but it never deals real damage
item.noellesroles.crystal_ball.tooltip:
Charge while aiming at a player, then mark them after 1 second
The marked player becomes your next accurate prophecy target
Single-use item, disappears after use
item.noellesroles.dream_imprint.tooltip:
Use on a player to protect one extra hit of life
Target will teleport to the user if the shield triggers and give a delusion count
Single use
item.noellesroles.phone.tooltip: Right-click to switch between Free Voice Group and Killer Voice Group
item.noellesroles.icon_ability_cooldown_:
Refresh cooldown of all killers' abilities and Psycho Mode
Activated instantly on purchase, 5 minutes cooldown
item.noellesroles.icon_potion_effect_ref:
Clear killers' potion effects
Activated instantly on purchase, 3 minutes cooldown
item.noellesroles.icon_weapon_cooldown_r:
Refresh cooldown of all killers' weapons
Activated instantly on purchase, 3 minutes cooldown
item.noellesroles.defense_vial.tooltip:
Right click on food/drink trays to use
Clears all poison applied to trays
Protects anyone who drinks a defensed drink one extra hit of life.
Invisible to other players.
item.noellesroles.delusion_vial.tooltip:
Right click on food/drink trays to use
Creates fakes poison, making the consumer of the poisoned item
think they are poisoned, but have no physical effect.
item.noellesroles.role_mine.tooltip:
Right click to Place down on Floors or Ceilings.
Invisible to other players, both placed and in hand.
item.noellesroles.timed_bomb.tooltip:
Right click a player to pass it to them. After a short delay, it starts beeping.
When the beep countdown ends, it explodes and kills whoever is holding it.
It can also be planted into trays and beds so the next interacting player gets tagged with the bomb.
item.noellesroles.sniper_rifle.tooltip:
A powerful long-range weapon with a 60-block reach
Its shot pierces every block along the path and deals damage that cannot be blocked by anything
Holding it slows you down and adds a 2 second deployment cooldown before firing, while aiming feels heavier than a revolver
It can load up to 5 rounds at once and enters a 4 second cooldown after firing
item.noellesroles.sniper_rifle_bullet.to:
Required ammunition for the sniper rifle
Pick this item up with left click, move it onto the sniper rifle slot, then right click the rifle to load it
item.noellesroles.hunting_knife.tooltip:
Right-click, hold for a second and get close to your victim
Compared to Knife, it has a longer holding-time
If stop holding after sprinting, two times holding-time cooldown
After a kill, cannot be used for 45 seconds
Attack to knock back / push a player (no cooldown)
item.noellesroles.blowgun.tooltip:
Point, right-click and shoot
The hit target will be poisoned
1 minute cooldown
item.noellesroles.knockout_drug.tooltip:
Use on a player to daze them for 30 seconds
The affected player will follow you
Use sneaking key to release them
Single use, 45 seconds cooldown
item.noellesroles.poison_injector.toolti:
Use on a player to poison them
If target has already been poisoned, directly cause death
1 minute cooldown
item.noellesroles.sulfuric_acid_barrel.t:
Use on a dead body to dissolve it
1 minute cooldown
item.noellesroles.toolbox.tooltip:
Right-click on a door blasted by a crowbar to repair it.
Cooldown: 20 seconds
item.noellesroles.capture_device.tooltip:
Capture devices can be placed on the floor or ceiling. This item is invisible to other players when held.
When placed on the floor, it will detect everyone except yourself.
nIf 1 or more players pass through the area, all players in the area (except yourself) will be immobilized for 5 seconds.\nA report will also be generated, recording the names of the captured players.
item.noellesroles.power_restoration.tool:
When in a power outage state, using the Power Restoration System can immediately eliminate one power outage effect.
Facing unexpected darkness, the Power Restoration System will perform its intended function.

item.noellesroles.sedative.tooltip:
Right click on food/drink trays to use
The consuming player gains a sedative effect and will not lose sanity for 45 seconds
The player's revolver firing cooldown is also halved while affected
If a Coward consumes it, danger pulses, heartbeat shaking, and revolver shake are all removed
Do not consume another sedative during the effect, or you will die from overdose
